This includes Hatred, Frenzy & Stupidity. Damnable Luck: While Slayers SEEK death, it often eerily avoids them. Slayers may never use armour of any kind, nor cloaks that provide a constant save bonus (though they may use Lucky Charms). Also, they may not use any missiles that aren't thrown, nor may they learn magic. Only in Victory: Slayer heroes do NOT gain exploration dice at the end of the battle if they were defeated or routed; they only gain them if they win the scenario, were allied with the winner, or tied. (Does not include the Rememberer.)
